Oakwood Residence Hanoi
Serviced Apartments in Hanoi
No. 17, Lane 35, Dang Thai Mai Street, Quang An Ward, Tay Ho District, 100000, Hanoi, Vietnam

Nestled in a peaceful alley by the picturesque West Lake, Oakwood Residence Hanoi offers a tranquil sanctuary for business and leisure travelers, as well as relocating families in an upscale residential area. Guests can seek repose in any of the 250 elegantly furnished serviced apartments or enjoy exclusive access to the facilities such as a restaurant, residents' lounge, fitness center and an all-season swimming pool. Surrounded by a plethora of dining establishments, retail shops and amenities, its central location also offers convenient access to Hanoi's central business district, government offices and embassies. Ciputra International City, where a number of international schools are located in, is also located in close proximity, perfect for relocating families.

Getting to Oakwood Residence Hanoi
From Noi Bai International Airport:

-
By Taxi: The journey covers approximately 23 kilometers via Nhat Tan Bridge and takes around 30 minutes under normal traffic conditions. The estimated cost ranges from VND 250,000 to VND 300,000 (depending on the vehicle type and taxi company).

-
By Public Airport Bus: You can catch the high-quality Express Bus No. 86 (Route: Noi Bai Airport - Hanoi Railway Station) directly at the arrival terminal island. Please disembark at the Au Co bus stop (near Lane 124 Au Co or Quang An Flower Market). From this stop, you can take a short taxi or ride-hailing trip of about 1.5 kilometers along Dang Thai Mai Street to reach the residence.

Nearest public transport from Oakwood Residence Hanoi
- Connecting Bus Stops:

- Xuan Dieu / Au Co Bus Stop: Approximately 1 to 1.5 kilometers from the residence. This stop serves the high-quality Express Bus No. 86 with a direct connection to Noi Bai International Airport, as well as Bus Routes 31 and 41 heading towards the Old Quarter.

- Railway Stations:

- Hanoi Railway Station (Le Duan Street): Approximately 6 kilometers from the residence (The main hub for North-South train routes).
- Long Bien Railway Station: Approximately 4.5 kilometers from the residence (Convenient for train routes towards Hai Phong and Lang Son).

Studio Deluxe King (published; official apartmentSize 33 sqm; 1 King-size bed; occupancy unpublished):
Settle into our bright, airy contemporary studio apartments, a perfect space designed for singles to retreat to and recharge in. Pamper yourself with a relaxing deep soak in the marble bathtub or refresh your senses with a rejuvenating rain shower in the en-suite bathroom. A deep, restful slumber awaits in the cozy bedroom, fitted with plush king bedding. Each apartment features a comprehensive suite of urban conveniences such as complimentary Wi-Fi; a fully-equipped kitchenette; combo washer/dryer; electronic in-room safe; flat screen TV with cable channels and a sound bar.

Studio Deluxe Twin (published; official apartmentSize 33 sqm; Twin beds; occupancy Max 3 Pax):
Our contemporary studio apartments offer the perfect oasis for travel-savvy traveling companions to rest and recharge in. Pamper yourself in our en-suite bathroom, fitted with a marble bathtub, separate rain shower as well as luxurious amenities. At the end of the day, retreat to the cozy bedroom where a good night's rest is guaranteed with the plush twin bedding. Each apartment features a comprehensive suite of urban conveniences such as complimentary Wi-Fi; a fully-equipped kitchenette; combo washer/dryer; electronic in-room safe; flat screen TV with cable channels and a sound bar.

One-Bedroom Deluxe Apartment (published; official apartmentSize 62 sqm; 1 King-size bed; occupancy Max 3 Pax):
Framed by picturesque views overlooking the lake or city, our one-bedroom apartments offer traveling companions or couples a spacious, tranquil space to unwind in. The elegantly furnished accommodation features a bright and airy living room which opens up to a private balcony, a dining area as well as a separate bedroom and en-suite bathroom. Unwind with a refreshing shower or pampering deep soak in the marble bath tub and enjoy a restful slumber with the plush bedding. Each apartment is appointed with complimentary Wi-Fi; a fully-equipped kitchen; washer/dryer; electronic in-room safe; flat screen TV with cable channels and a sound bar.

Two-Bedroom Deluxe Apartment (published; official apartmentSize 83 sqm; 1 King-size bed and 1 single-size bed; occupancy unpublished):
Perfectly designed for small groups of traveling companions and young families, our elegantly dressed two-bedroom apartments offer ample living and dining space to unwind in or catch up with friends. Enjoy the company of spectacular views in private or with loved ones from the full-length balcony, which is accessible from the living room as well as the master bedroom. Enjoy the plush comfort offered by the king-sized and single bed offered in the master and second bedroom respectively, and pamper yourself with a relaxing, deep soak in the marble bathtub or refreshing rain shower in either of the two bathrooms. Each apartment is appointed with complimentary Wi-Fi; a fully-equipped kitchen which includes a dishwasher and separate washer/ dryer; electronic in-room safe and flat screen TV with a sound bar.

Two-Bedroom Family Deluxe Apartment (published; official apartmentSize 96 sqm; 1 King-size bed and Twin beds; occupancy Max 5 Pax):
Our two-bedroom family deluxe apartments are the ideal choice for vacationing families seeking a more spacious, idyllic sanctuary. Enjoy a moment of repose and unwind in the company of picturesque views and breeze in the private, full-length balcony - which opens up from the living room as well as the master bedroom; catch up on business and entertainment news in the brightly-lit living room or host intimate dinner parties in the dining area, adjacent to the fully-equipped kitchen. At the end of the day, take a pampering soak in the marble bathroom or refreshing rain shower in either of the two en-suite bathrooms and enjoy a deep slumber in the master or second bedroom, fitted with a king-sized and twin beds respectively. Each apartment is appointed with complimentary Wi-Fi; a fully-equipped kitchen which includes a dishwasher and separate washer/ dryer; electronic in-room safe and flat screen TV with a sound bar.

Three-Bedroom Deluxe Apartment (published; official apartmentSize 128 sqm; 2 King-size beds and Twin beds; occupancy unpublished):
Designed to deliver ultimate comfort and convenience of a private residence for larger families, our three-bedroom apartments combine style and functionality within a spacious, contemporary living environment. With dual-key accessibility to private spaces of a studio and two-bedroom unit within, unwind with friends in style in the generously-sized living room or enjoy a private moment of repose in the luxury of the private balcony, which comes furnished with a table and chairs. Host intimate dinner parties in the dining area adjacent to the fully-equipped kitchen, fitted with a dishwasher and separate washer and dryer. Rejuvenate your senses with a rain shower or take a pampering, deep soak in the marble bathtub in both bathrooms. Retreat to the bedrooms, fitted with a dedicated nook with a study desk and enjoy elevated comfort with the plush king bedding the first two bedrooms, and twin bedding in the third bedroom. Enjoy the complimentary Wi-Fi; electronic in-room safe and flat screen TV with a sound bar; available in every apartment.

Three/Four/Five-Bedroom Penthouse (unpublished; official apartmentSize 420 sqm; 3-5 King-size beds; occupancy unpublished):
Our penthouses are a treat for families seeking an experience that epitomizes extravagant luxury, comfort and privacy; framed by breathtaking panoramic views of West Lake from the comfort of the private balcony. Unwind in the spacious living room and catch up with loved ones or friends over a casual afternoon tea or celebratory meal in the private dining area, adjacent to the fully-equipped kitchen. Each lavish bedroom is fitted with plush king bedding and fine linens, generous walk-in closets, a private nook for the work desk as well as an en-suite bathroom with a marble bathtub and premium rain shower. Enjoy extra convenience with two additional bathrooms, which features a refreshing rain shower each. Each apartment is appointed with complimentary Wi-Fi; a fully-equipped kitchen which includes a dishwasher and separate washer/ dryer; electronic in-room safe and flat screen TV with a sound bar

description:
Somerset West Point Hanoi
Upscale Serviced Apartments in Hanoi
No. 2 Tay Ho Road, Tay Ho Ward, Hanoi, Vietnam

Somerset West Point Hanoi offers a distinguished living experience in the vibrant Tay Ho Ward, perfectly positioned by the scenic West Lake. This upscale residential area is highly favoured by expatriates, offering a peaceful environment while remaining exceptionally well connected to the city's dynamic pulse. The property’s strategic location near the main Au Co road provides straightforward access to Hanoi’s established business district (Hoan Kiem), the burgeoning new business district in west Hanoi, and Noi Bai International Airport, ensuring optimal convenience for global travellers.

Our collection of 284 thoughtfully designed apartments ranges from comfortable studios to expansive four-bedroom layouts, including elegant penthouses, all crafted to suit your individual needs. Each residence provides a private balcony, often with captivating views of West Lake or the city, creating a serene backdrop for your stay. Inside, you will discover contemporary décor, a fully equipped modern kitchen, and reliable wireless internet access, ensuring you feel completely at home, whether relocating for business or enjoying an extended holiday.

Guests at Somerset West Point Hanoi benefit from a wide array of exclusive facilities and signature services designed to enhance comfort and convenience. Maintain your fitness routine in our well-appointed gymnasium, enjoy a refreshing dip in the swimming pool, or relax in the sauna and steam rooms. For families, a dedicated children's playroom and wading pool are available. Leisure facilities include a golf simulator and a welcoming residents' lounge.

We ensure a seamless, secure residential experience with 24-hour reception and 24/7 on-call wellness and security services. Accessible facilities are provided throughout the property. Our dedicated team offers daily housekeeping, laundry, and dry cleaning services, as well as business centre support. To explore the local area or venture further afield, our concierge can assist with car hire referrals, airport transfers, and shuttle bus services. Serviced apartments in Hanoi, Vietnam

Cherish the moment
Elegant living with an iconic view

Nestled in an exceptional location on the fringes of Hanoi’s scenic West lake (Tay Ho), Diamond Westlake Suites is a unique resort-style premium residence offering an exclusive experience with reliable services with over twenty-five years proven track record of stability.

Featuring 165 classily furnished serviced suites from one to four-bedroom, the numerous ranges of services, leisure and sport facilities will perfectly match your active lifestyle. Meanwhile, the surrounding scenic and lavish nature will make you feel like in a resort, offering a feeling of smooth and unhurried style of living. Make the most of the landscaping and bespoke green space whilst enjoying the comfort of your apartments.

Safe and family oriented through a wide varieties of activities and events all year-long, you will also find multiple nearby restaurants, cafes and retail shops which whom we’ve partnered to offer you the most of your stay in Hanoi.

Live with us
Stay at Diamond Westlake Suites to experience a resort-style living experience at the gates of Hanoi Capital. Indulge yourself in an oasis of calm and serene where the green lush will bring moments of relaxation away from the bustling of the city. Perfect destination for relocating families in Hanoi, the playground will become the best playmate of your children, evolving in a safe and attentioned environment.

Featuring 165 suites, most apartments offer a private balcony, boasting stunning lake view and / or swimming-pool view. All apartments are equipped with fully equipped kitchen, centralized air-conditionning, 55″ smart TV, convenient separate spaces to eat, rest, sleep and work. Complimentary wifi is accessible from the apartment and all public areas and a complimentary car park is allocated during your stay.

Continental buffet breakfast options with warm and cold dishes, local and international specialties and fresh pastries are served daily in our Verandah restaurant. “À la carte” lunch and dinner are also available dine-in and room service.

Ideally located on the Quang An peninsula and overlooking the West lake, Diamond Westlake Suites benefits of a privileged situation in a residential area coveted by relocating families. Discover plenty of dining restaurants and retail shops in the surroundings while most of international schools can be accessible by shuttle. The Hanoi Old Quarter that is served daily by our complimentary shuttle bus is only 20′ away while it will take you less than 30 minutes to reach Noi Bai International airport.

Suites / apartments
Discover our stylish suites that will answer all your needs. From one to four-bedroom apartments, we provide accomodations suitable for all types of trips whether you are business or leisure travelers looking for short or long-term stay in Hanoi. Each of our suites are designed for comfort and practicability offering fully equipped kitchen and contemporary furniture. While most of our suites offer a stunning view over the Hanoi West lake, our dedicated team is here to provide a reliable 24h/24 assistance.

The Gloria by Silk Path - Luxury Serviced Apartments in Hanoi City Center

The apartment complex fulfills the three highly sought-after “tam cận” criteria in Vietnamese real estate: proximity to the market, proximity to water source, and proximity to main roads. With its adjacency to the Thanh Cong market, its location on the major Nguyen Hong street, and the serene views of Thanh Cong Lake, it creates an ideal living environment—prosperous, peaceful, and perfect for a sophisticated, elegant community.
From The Gloria, residents can easily connect with Hanoi’s most memorable cultural and historical destinations. Immerse yourself in the vibrant local life with classic cafés, local eateries, bustling traditional markets, and lush four-season parks just a few steps away.
